About the inn

Built for people passing through Ghatshila — and for those who keep coming back

Koustav Inn opened in 2024 on Kashida Road, close to the transport corridors that bring travellers into town and a short walk from the Subarnarekha's banks. Rooms are cleaned daily and turned around properly between guests — not just tidied.

Some guests are here for a wedding down the road; others are breaking a Howrah–Tatanagar train journey, or spending a weekend at Burudi Lake and Fuldungri's hills. The inn is built to work equally well for a one-night stopover and a five-night family stay.

Rooms & suites

Three ways to stay, all with the same daily clean

Every category comes with air conditioning, fresh linen, and a proper en-suite bathroom — the difference is space, and how many people you're travelling with.

Deluxe AC Room

A cosy double, well suited to couples and solo travellers who mostly want quiet.

Executive Premium Suite

More floor space, a proper desk, and a seating corner — useful if you're here for work too.

Grand Family Suite

Built for families and small groups who want adjoining rooms and their own space.

Beyond the rooms

A hall on-site for the bigger occasions

Alongside the rooms, Koustav Inn runs an open function hall on the property — used for wedding-party stays, family functions, and get-togethers that need more room than a lobby can offer.

It's booked separately from the rooms, so if you're planning something larger, mention it to the front desk alongside your room dates.

Getting around

Burudi Lake

~5 km

A lake ringed by low forested hills — good for a sunset walk, a slow boat ride or a picnic.

Dharagiri Falls

Past Burudi Lake

A small forest waterfall about 6 km beyond Burudi Lake — at its best during and just after the monsoon.

A gentle climb with wide green views over the town, best done early before the heat sets in.
